issues.issue: Eminescu and Maiorescu are school-canon literary figures. The Iași national literary museum verifies Junimea participation and publication context. The journal itself explicitly describes Maiorescu withdrawing from its leadership in1895, resolving the adversarial concern about the existing broad a condus revista edge. This supports intellectual/editorial leadership, not a claim that he was sole formal redactor/director instead of Iacob Negruzzi. Academy membership is a valid third relation but Eminescu membership is posthumous; simultaneous membership is not claimed. Two distinctive Junimea/journal routes remain legible without knowing the less obvious Academy alternative.
